theorems.name: Submission.codim1_hcp_sc_weingarten_codazzi
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (A₀ : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (ν : Euclid P → Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ A₀ = m + 1 → M ⊆ (A₀ : Set (Euclid P)) → (∀ r : ℕ, IsEmbeddedSubmanifold r m M) → (∃ O : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen O ∧ M ⊆ O ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ν O) → (∀ x ∈ M, ν x ∈ A₀ ∧ ‖ν x‖ = 1 ∧ ∀ v ∈ tangentSpace M x, inner ℝ (ν x) v = 0) → ∀ x ∈ M, ∀ a ∈ tangentSpace M x, ∀ b ∈ tangentSpace M x, fderiv ℝ ν x a ∈ tangentSpace M x ∧ inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ ν x a) b = inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ ν x b) a ∧ ∀ d ∈ tangentSpace M x, inner ℝ (fderivWithin ℝ (fun y => (fderiv ℝ ν y).comp (Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M y)).starProjection) M x a b) d = inner ℝ (fderivWithin ℝ (fun y => (fderiv ℝ ν y).comp (Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M y)).starProjection) M x b a) d ∧ inner ℝ (fderivWithin ℝ (fun y => (fderiv ℝ ν y).comp (Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M y)).starProjection) M x a b) d = inner ℝ (fderivWithin ℝ (fun y => (fderiv ℝ ν y).comp (Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M y)).starProjection) M x a d) b
